budget_policy.controlled_equal_input: Before each matched run, predeclare the same source opportunity and comparable call/token/tool/currency envelope where measurable. Record any unavoidable product difference; do not invent a universal time or search-round cutoff.
budget_policy.fixture_only: A scripted fixture has only its listed events and sources; this does not prove any live resource capacity.
budget_policy.native_workflow: Before each native run, record the authorized spend/resource envelope and product features. Native tools remain available; compare observed usage and disclose non-equivalent capacity.

illustrative_controlled_allowance.note: A concrete proposed evaluation allowance for a controlled synthetic comparison, to be reviewed and declared before any actual run. It is not an observed spend, a runtime research limit, or a scientific duration cap.

comparison_arms.rule: Record exact build, model, roles, tools, route access, and configuration.
Use the same selected model and question as the pipeline, with matched evidence opportunity in the controlled condition. Record tool differences and omit peer exchange.

Use a strong current ChatGPT or Codex research workflow. In the native condition allow its normal authorized tools; record product/model/version, features, source access, and human intervention rather than handicapping it.

conditions.interpretation: Tests reasoning and workflow over comparable evidence opportunity; does not measure live discovery breadth.
conditions.source_access: The same pinned task and source snapshots are supplied to every eligible system. Record any unmatched tool or product feature instead of silently disabling it.

conditions.interpretation: Tests product-native usefulness. Record actual source access, tools, versions, intervention, and cost; do not claim equal evidence opportunity.
conditions.source_access: Supply the same question and decision, then allow each product's documented native research and browsing workflow under recorded authorization.
